query:
UPDATE products
        SET name = COALESCE($2, name),
            sku = CASE
                WHEN $3::text IS NULL THEN sku
                WHEN $3 = '' THEN NULL
                ELSE $3
            END,
            unit_price = COALESCE($4::float8, unit_price),
            is_active = COALESCE($5, is_active)
        WHERE id = $1
        RETURNING id
